hero.lead: Rooftop solar designed, installed and serviced from Patiala — across all 23 districts. Subsidy filed, paperwork handled, generating in 21 days.

marquee: PM SURYA GHAR FILED FOR YOU

costShrink.title: Watch your bill shrink.
costShrink.lead: On day 1, your bill drops to almost nothing. The few hundred rupees you still pay covers the meter rental and any night-time grid usage. The savings start immediately.

quickCheck.title: Is solar right for your roof?
quickCheck.lead: Three honest yes-or-no questions. We'll tell you the truth — even if the answer is "wait a year".

howItWorks.title:
From bill shock to power-on
in twenty-one days.
howItWorks.lead: One team. Six steps. Every form, every wire, every inspection — handled. No contractors disappearing after the deposit. No DISCOM runaround.
howItWorks.promise: If we miss the 21-day mark, we pay your next month's bill. In writing, on every contract.

timeline.title:
From "yes" to power-on,
tracked day by day.
timeline.lead: Other installers say "21 days" and ghost. We send you a WhatsApp update at every milestone — and a guarantee in writing if we slip.

liveGen.title:
Six thousand roofs.
One sun. Working for them all.
liveGen.lead: Every panel we've installed is online and reporting back. Watch the meters tick — these are the real units our customers are generating right now.

packages.title:
Or skip the math —
pick a package.
packages.lead: Three sizes that fit 90% of Punjab homes. Tier-1 components only. Subsidy already applied to the price you see.

partners.title:
Tier-1 only.
No grey-market panels.
partners.lead: We only sell what we'd put on our own roof. These are the brands that survive 25 Punjab summers — others fail in 5.

story.title:
Ranjit ji's bill went from
₹6,800 to ₹380.
story.lead: 5 kW system, single-floor home in Patiala's Tripuri colony. Installed January 2026. Subsidy of ₹78,000 landed in his account 27 days after commissioning.

trust.title:
Punjab's roofs deserve
a Punjab installer.
trust.lead: We've been wiring panels onto roofs from Pathankot to Fazilka since 2018. Here's what we do differently.

gallery.title: Across all 23 districts.
gallery.lead: A few of the rooftops we've recently powered. Real systems, real owners — we'll connect you to any of them.

Up to ₹78,000
off your install.

faq.title:
Things people
actually ask.

your last.
